verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Unleash serves an llms.txt at docs.getunleash.io that contains an explicit "Instructions for AI Agents" section. That section tells agents to append `.md` to any page URL to get clean Markdown, and the many .md doc URLs in the pack are consistent with this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming the llms.txt or the Markdown docs effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.getunleash.io/llms.txt # Unleash Documentation
For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
